lessons.mechanism: 正则case-sensitive按固定keyword优先序返单strength；feature dataclass静态registry，字符串revision比较；add_months年月算术；SpecServer直接dict handle模拟server/discover/_meta/version error，Client直接method call日志无网络。
limitations_corrected_or_explicit: keyword substring不理解多句/quoted文本/范围或义务主体，首个高优先词不等整段规范含义；BCP14大写特定义务与普通规范文本的作用需分开，不能只用classifier判断合规
add_months保原day可返回Feb31/非闰Feb29；未校合法ISO日期/月份类型或未来revision；feature_state在引入前也可能返active、没有restoreActive/followcycle完整模型
SpecServer没核jsonrpc2/id类型与唯一性/params/metatypes，非法list可能异常；工具式直接dict fixture不是SDK/真实server conformance
test transcript只检查已有result.resultType合法，不核错误code/id/meta/时序或完整schema
静态revision_states当前2026-07-28不作永远Current，官方registry对HTTP+SSE是policy过渡3month特殊条款，不能统一12month
输出reference聚焦实义但schema与prose不一致需复核规范/修订，不盲以字符串keyword覆盖语义
lessons.disposition: 复用现MCP主章/通信状态与conformance/operations主题；补规范读取与日期calendar正确性，考试时间管理不新增33来源概要。

lessons.knowledge: N×M→N+M是接口复用的理想计数模型；规范协商、功能与schema/传输/权限约束仍决定实际互操作，不能声称任何现代client能驱动任意server。
lessons.mechanism: 两个Server dataclass注册Tool/definition，统一Client直接handle；按version/meta拒绝、discover/cache hints/list排序、tools_call查name/required再handler固定天气/票号，无网络或SDK。
limitations_corrected_or_explicit: N+M不是实际成本承诺，兼容version、features、schemas、auth、hostpolicy还需协商与验证
Tool仅查required key presence，没有校type/additionalProperties/值域；city:null或list可能继续handler，count工具宣称additionalProperties false却忽略extra
handlers固定Pune天气24C、TCK101/3tickets，没有真实业务/副作用/数据service，不说明工具质量
handle没有核完整JSONRPC2/id或params/metatypes，直接dict调用可异常；正常fixtureresultType测试不证schema完整合规
一个Client接两个server只是同class分别实例，serverinfo/工具definition不自动可信；modelcontrolled不绕过host授权/用户决策
source错误频道教学适用于给定revision，schema-invalid tool argument与protocol-invalid envelope要分层，不能将所有badparams都自选isError
lessons.disposition: 复用MCP核心/工具调用章节并补互操作前提、schema实际校验和可信边界；N+M宣传成本不作为实测降本数字。

lessons.knowledge: host/client/server逻辑隔离、localprocess/remote网络信任边界、角色controlled不代替授权、发现按server与工具冲突由可信hostid路由。
lessons.mechanism: Host按配置server_id连每Server对象一个Client，discover记录cap/serverInfo，sorted connection IDs构registry仅tools cap存在就list，重复name用serverid/name；route映射回localname。stdio/http只是Server.transport字符串，文件/notes handlers为固定text。
limitations_corrected_or_explicit: 同进程对象fixture不执行子进程/stdio/HTTP/header/OAuth，client对象逻辑分离不是OS sandbox或conversation数据隔离证明
Host.connect重复id会覆盖已有连接，cap仅keypresence无schema验证；registry的prefix可能与其它合法hostkey碰撞，没有collision递归/保留命名空间
所谓firstdeclare保barekey实际sorted(server_ids)先者，不是连接/发现顺序；后来加更早id可换canonicalroute，需稳定mapping/revision/批准绑定
serverInfo不能可信cache/routing但hostid也要唯一稳定与配置endpoint绑定，不只是换成任意string
nameprefixnotes/search是host内部alias，source工具命名SHOULD范围不允许slash，route已映回localname，但modelbackend函数name规则还需编码与可逆映射
Server仅查PV/CAPS key存在，没核version/type/JSONRPC/args完整schema；tools同名register静默覆盖，route没真实consent或作用域检查
本capabilities resources已声明但没有真正resources/list；公开discover/list返回dict引用对象可在fixtureclient直接改，不等wire隔离
lessons.disposition: 现MCP核心host/client与发现聚合深度内容复用，补配置id稳定/前缀冲突、canonical漂移与逻辑隔离≠sandbox，no-new来源概要。

def test_every_request_carries_protocol_version_and_capabilities(self) -> None:
        requests = [message for message in self.result.transcript if "method" in message]
        self.assertTrue(requests)
        for request in requests:
            meta = request["params"]["_meta"]
            self.assertEqual(meta[main.PV_KEY], main.PROTOCOL_VERSION)
            self.assertIsInstance(meta[main.CAPS_KEY], dict)

def test_confirmation_gate_blocks_a_destructive_call_when_denied(self) -> None:
        close_calls = [
            request for request, _ in self.pairs.values()
            if request is not None and request["params"].get("name") == "close_ticket"
        ]
        closed_ids = [call["params"]["arguments"]["ticket_id"] for call in close_calls]
        self.assertEqual(closed_ids, ["TCK-1"])
        self.assertEqual(self.result.closed, ["TCK-1"])
        self.assertEqual(self.result.denied, ["TCK-2"])

def test_tool_execution_error_is_fed_back_and_the_corrected_call_succeeds(self) -> None:
        forecast_calls = [
            (request, result) for request, result in self.pairs.values()
            if request is not None and request["params"].get("name") == "get_forecast"
        ]
        self.assertEqual(len(forecast_calls), 2)
        first_request, first_result = forecast_calls[0]
        second_request, second_result = forecast_calls[1]
        self.assertEqual(first_request["params"]["arguments"], {})
        self.assertTrue(first_result["result"]["isError"])
        self.assertNotEqual(first_request["id"], second_request["id"])
        self.assertEqual(second_request["params"]["arguments"]["city"], "Pune")
        self.assertFalse(second_result["result"]["isError"])
        self.assertIn("Pune", second_result["result"]["content"][0]["text"])

tests_static_only.name: test_input_required_result_interrupts_the_loop_until_answered
tests_static_only.source_assertions:
def test_input_required_result_interrupts_the_loop_until_answered(self) -> None:
        open_calls = [
            (request, result) for request, result in self.pairs.values()
            if request is not None and request["params"].get("name") == "open_ticket"
        ]
        self.assertEqual(len(open_calls), 2)
        first_request, first_result = open_calls[0]
        second_request, second_result = open_calls[1]
        self.assertNotIn("inputResponses", first_request["params"])
        self.assertEqual(first_result["result"]["resultType"], "input_required")
        self.assertIn("priority", first_result["result"]["inputRequests"])
        self.assertIn("inputResponses", second_request["params"])
        self.assertEqual(second_result["result"]["resultType"], "complete")
        self.assertEqual(second_result["result"]["structuredContent"]["priority"], "high")

def test_subscription_stream_acknowledges_before_reporting_a_change(self) -> None:
        client = main.Client(main.build_tool_server())
        before = len(client.list_all_tool_definitions())
        listen_request = client.open_listen({"toolsListChanged": True})
        ack = client.log[-1]
        self.assertEqual(ack["method"], "notifications/subscriptions/acknowledged")
        self.assertEqual(ack["params"]["_meta"][main.SUBSCRIPTION_ID_KEY], listen_request["id"])
        client.server.add_tool(main.build_triage_incident_tool())
        client.server.queue_tools_list_changed(listen_request["id"])
        changed = client.expect_list_changed()
        self.assertEqual(changed["params"]["_meta"][main.SUBSCRIPTION_ID_KEY], listen_request["id"])
        after = len(client.list_all_tool_definitions())
        self.assertEqual(after, before + 1)
        closed = client.close_listen(listen_request)
        self.assertEqual(closed["result"]["resultType"], "complete")
        self.assertEqual(closed["result"]["_meta"][main.SUBSCRIPTION_ID_KEY], listen_request["id"])

lessons.knowledge: Tasks per-request扩展与server-directed创建，RPC complete不是工作完成；input/取消/TTL/持久可见性、owner与worker租约各自合同。
lessons.mechanism: Task UUID截12hex、实际UTC秒时间、tasks内存dict，advance手动working/input_required/completed；update只action accept删除待答key，cancel直接终态，snapshot浅引用，无真实worker。
limitations_corrected_or_explicit: 内存Task不是durablestore，插入后本对象get可见不证跨进程/重启/最终一致；48bit随机ID不等授权或生产不可猜保证
没有owner/principal/scope，任何知道id的Client可get/update/cancel；TTL只字段无过期/清理
update不校content.approved isTrue或requestedSchema，accept+approvedFalse/无content也能推进部署
只声明Tasks而没elicitation，创建/轮询CAPS也无elicitation却发form输入；缺每次当前mode/types许可
terminal failed分支/error未实现且cancel只保护completed/cancelled，failed可被覆盖；结果直接可变引用可被调用者污染
普通fallback与Task最终deployed不同，只固定字符串/内存模拟，不执行install/test/deploy；合作取消被特定即刻cancel政策简化
args/cap settings仅presence、不完整JSONRPC/schema；输入keys去重、poll时序、workerlease、并发race/recovery没实现
长请求不被协议普遍禁止，也可用业务durablehandle/idempotency恢复，源码说任何阻塞完全无恢复过绝对
lessons.disposition: 复用现专题06§8持久Tasks/owner/lease与§9时钟/取消；补false批准/能力/TTL/浅引用和原tests范围，不复制弱内存Task。

lessons.knowledge: host受用户授权控制平面、TCB与server/model外部数据权力分开；自报identity/hints不凭证，跨server建议由用户任务/政策授权，不由LLM自行创造。
lessons.mechanism: ContextItem公开zone、trustedset calendar；正则CALL server.tool隔离，未命中默认允许并称modelownchoice；icons prefix https/data，localLaunch只hostzone允许任意command；三fixed mockserver，无启动/攻击/安装。
limitations_corrected_or_explicit: 特定CALL regex不识别paraphrase/Unicode/编码/多语言，server/tool名含点的greedy匹配可错；未命中不是model真实独立选择或授权证明
模型选择不能产生权力；图trusted model/灰data过门变蓝不可理解为外部数据已可信
zone可构造修改、Server.registered_id公开字段不是真实host绑定，trustedset需endpoint/artifact/policy关联
localLaunch不核command等于config文本、不核明确批准/env/args/hash/版本，hostconfig标签不证明SEP1024许可
icon只prefix，缺origin/MIME/SVG/字节/redirect/credentials-free验证，允许任意data不能称安全
trusted annotations原dict没typed/defaults，casefold可能混同标准case-sensitive Tool；fallback只是谨慎判断
Server无完整PV/schema/id/权限，返回删除/归档词都是fixed strings；安全或真实副作用未执行
owned client/导入config/模型不因名义在host内自动trusted，TCB假设需审核最小权限与撤权
lessons.disposition: 复用治理07/核心MCP provenance与host准入；补regex不是防注入、具体command批准和图标字节、LLM无授权权。

lessons.knowledge: 三OAuth roles/PRM-AS发现、PKCE S256/resource/state/issuer/aud/expiry/scope各独立；Bearer不证明用户批准具体副作用，token不上URI/passthrough。
lessons.mechanism: regexWWW与URL列表、metadata issuer等值、secrets verifier/hashchallenge、两请求dataclass、iss4rows；预置AccessToken registry按value+aud比较，McpServerfixedrotate、client给log加HTTP/WWW头，没有AS/browser/JWT/HTTP。
limitations_corrected_or_explicit: Token没issuer/signature/expiry/introspection、scopes有字段却没有核，默认空scope token也accepted；403只文档不能称完整授权
state仅生成、未保存或核callbackstate/TTL/单用，code/redirect/client/PKCE交易不真验证；TokenRequest可给不匹配verifier
canonical_resource丢query/无条件strip有义末slash、lower整个netloc含userinfo，可能混resource边界；无HTTPS/port/SSRF/URI完整validation
WWW regex只双引号，没多challenge/escaped/大小写；发现只是URL构造，不fetch/redirect/DNS/size/PRM.resource与AS列表验证
PKCE methods可错type string子串通过，verifier无长度/字符/type核；默认32bytes数学不是真实ASredeem
McpServer不核method/toolname/credid权限/schema/PV支持，返回rotatedTrue只是fixedpayload，没有真实keyrotation/userapproval
client自行加401WWW头到日志，非server实际捕获；真实tokens不得像fake例一样明文输出
stdio环境不免第三方权限审核；metadata/issuer函数单点不证完整mix-up防护或完整OAuth；本任务不API/登录/源码执行

def test_registered_client_call_carries_bearer_token_and_required_headers(self) -> None:
        scenario = main.run_scenario()
        wrapped_requests = [entry for entry in scenario["client"].log if isinstance(entry, dict) and "http" in entry]
        self.assertEqual(len(wrapped_requests), 2)
        discover_entry, call_entry = wrapped_requests
        self.assertTrue(discover_entry["http"]["headers"]["Authorization"].startswith("Bearer cc-token."))
        self.assertEqual(discover_entry["http"]["headers"]["Mcp-Method"], "server/discover")
        self.assertEqual(call_entry["http"]["headers"]["Mcp-Name"], "list_open_incidents")

def test_mrtr_retry_uses_a_new_id_and_echoes_request_state_exactly(self) -> None:

        prompt_id = self.client.log[-2]["id"]

            input_responses={"confirm": {"action": "accept", "content": {"approved": True}}},

        retry_request_state = self.client.log[-2]["params"]["requestState"]
        self.assertNotEqual(retry_id, prompt_id)
        self.assertEqual(retry_request_state, state)

lessons.knowledge: 描述/result不可信，whole descriptor pin只证明稳定；注册/刷新/调用都核政策，拒绝通道区分wire与业务policy；tokenaud上游凭证、SSRF/供应链各有独立证据。
lessons.mechanism: 7phrase子串扫描，递归只http/https $ref；sortedJSON hash descriptor；register存tool，observe存pending新hash/definition并quarantine，approve盲开status和pin；调用required计数及上下游token字符串等值，handlerfake字符串，13tests。
limitations_corrected_or_explicit: pin含describe4fields，但没有outputSchema/icons/title/_meta/执行artifact；mutable Tool/schema可直接改未observe导致call不核currenthash，register同name可覆盖approved记录
observe不扫描新description或networkref；approve无reviewer/auth/policy证据，也不更新state.tool至pending_definition，批准hash与真正执行descriptor可分离
phrase只是tripwire，结果完全不扫描，无模型/攻防实验；正例quarantine不会证明无攻击
find_network_ref只starts lowercasehttp，漏relative/$id/URI形式与其它scheme；注册拒$ref比协议禁止autoFetch更强，不是任何networkref定义都无效
token防护只inbound非None且exact相等，different string当成功不验issuer/aud/expiry/scope，不阻其它字段/headers透传；日志args含faketoken实际secret不得记
rate_limit是单server tool生存期计数，无caller/timewindow/refill/并发原子/跨worker，不限时率；先increment再handler异常会计费，无sandbox/deadline实现
no real discovery/routing/qualified names/nonce/SSRFfetch/DNS/Origin/icons/Registryadmission，图8风险和artifact10不等代码已实现10防护
input只required presence，no schema验证/metaenvelope/method/version/caps；falseargs被coerce{}，类型异常可raise；source强禁整个legacyband属于新实现策略，not所有旧兼容MUSTNOT
lessons.disposition: 现治理07§1–2/2.3已含完整descriptor/directcall/政策/ratelimit，复用唯一入口；补pending pin与执行对象一致性、重复register/直接mutate、scanner coverage不冒安全结论。

def test_every_request_in_the_transcript_carries_meta_protocol_fields(self) -> None:

            for entry in self.transcript

        for request in requests:

            self.assertIsInstance(meta[main.PV_KEY], str)

def test_mrtr_consent_round_trip_uses_a_new_id_and_echoes_request_state_exactly(self) -> None:
        server = main.build_server()
        client = main.Client("alice-oncall", server)
        args = {"service": "checkout-api", "environment": "production"}
        ask = client.send("tools/call", {"name": "restart_service", "arguments": args}, capabilities=main.ELICIT_CAPS)
        self.assertEqual(ask["result"]["resultType"], "input_required")
        self.assertIn("confirm", ask["result"]["inputRequests"])
        state = ask["result"]["requestState"]
        ask_request = client.log[-2]
        retry = client.send(
            "tools/call", {"name": "restart_service", "arguments": args}, capabilities=main.ELICIT_CAPS,
            input_responses={"confirm": {"action": "accept", "content": {"confirmed": True}}}, request_state=state,
        )
        retry_request = client.log[-2]
        self.assertNotEqual(retry_request["id"], ask_request["id"])
        self.assertEqual(retry_request["params"]["requestState"], state)
        self.assertFalse(retry["result"]["isError"])
        self.assertTrue(retry["result"]["structuredContent"]["restarted"])

def test_task_completes_via_polling(self) -> None:
        server = main.build_server()

def test_trace_id_is_preserved_across_every_hop_of_the_narrative(self) -> None:

            entry["message"] if isinstance(entry, dict) and "message" in entry else entry

standard_quiz_mapping.question: What does a domain's weight in the MCPA blueprint most directly tell a candidate?
all_options: The order in which the five domains appear in the official guide
The share of exam questions drawn from that domain, on average
The minimum score a candidate must reach in that domain alone
The number of official training hours required before attempting it
standard_quiz_mapping.original_explanation: A domain's published weight is its share of the blueprint, the proportion of exam content the domain represents; it does not set a reading order, a required hour count, or a per-domain minimum score.
standard_quiz_mapping.learning_judgment_chinese: 源正确1：weight表示固定源蓝图的域份额，不能变成每域最低分/必修小时/顺序；当前考务未核，主正文不固化考试数字。
standard_quiz_mapping.scope: 源候选含条件/过强时以中文判断与主章节为准，不按固定位置计能力；17/3明确纠错1

A true, still current requirement

standard_quiz_mapping.question: A candidate scores 100 percent in MCP Fundamentals, weighted 16 percent, and 0 percent everywhere else. Why is a weighted readiness estimate more useful here than a plain five-way average?
all_options: It rounds every domain score upward so the candidate always looks prepared
It shows readiness near 16 percent instead of a misleading 20 percent average
It replaces the five domains with a single combined pass or fail flag
It discards the weakest domain scores before computing any final result
standard_quiz_mapping.original_explanation: A plain average shows 20 percent because one of five domains is perfect, but a weighted estimate reflects that the mastered domain is only 16 percent of the exam, which is a more honest picture of overall readiness.

assessment_mapping.original_explanation: Portability follows directly from where logic is supposed to live: a client that discovers capabilities and tools through the protocol, rather than hardcoding one server's specifics, can drive any compliant server it has never seen. Custom, server-specific assumptions baked into a client are exactly what breaks that portability.
assessment_mapping.learning_judgment_chinese: 原C(2)通用discovery/data+共同wire/版本/能力/auth/schema业务条件减少hardcode，单server测试不证明全部其它服务兼容。

assessment_mapping.scope: practice原题非官方考试，单选规律不足以评估能力，按语义与边界自检

assessment_mapping.original_prompt: A platform team is deciding whether a new extension can be turned on for every user by default the moment a vendor SDK adds support for it. What does the specification's extension design actually require here?
all_options: The host must wait for the extension's identifier to change to a -v2 suffix before enabling it
Nothing further at all, since any extension a client's own SDK supports is automatically enabled for every single request
The extension must first be promoted from Tier 3 to Tier 1 before it can ever be declared
Explicit opt-in on both sides, since extensions are disabled by default, which is where governance sign-off belongs
assessment_mapping.original_explanation: Extensions are disabled by default and require explicit opt-in through declared capabilities on both the client and server side, which is a deliberate design choice, not an accident of SDK support. That deliberate opt-in point is precisely where a platform team's governance review naturally fits before wide rollout.
assessment_mapping.learning_judgment_chinese: 原D(3)双方明确support并应用enable/治理policy，SDK支持不等默认运行；opt-in能力格式不能冒用户批准每具体effect。

formal_destinations.heading: ### 8.5 采用矩阵要落到负责人和可观察证据

assessment_mapping.scope: practice原题非官方考试，单选规律不足以评估能力，按语义与边界自检

assessment_mapping.original_prompt: A developer is deciding whether to expose a purely internal helper function, called only within the same process and never crossing an application or trust boundary, as an MCP tool. Is this a good fit for MCP?
all_options: No, since MCP is built for crossing the boundary between an application and an external system, and this helper never crosses it
No, but only because internal helper functions are always too fast for JSON-RPC to keep up with
Yes, since any function at all becomes more valuable once it is exposed through a protocol
Yes, since MCP technically always requires every single function anywhere in a codebase to eventually always be reachable as a tool too
assessment_mapping.original_explanation: MCP exists to standardize context and actions crossing the boundary between an AI application and an external system. A same-process internal helper never crosses that boundary, so wrapping it as a tool adds serialization and discovery overhead without the interoperability benefit that justifies using the protocol in the first place.
assessment_mapping.learning_judgment_chinese: 原A(0)同process单内部helper无边界收益直接函数，若未来第二消费者/可信隔离需求条件变，MCP非强制所有helper。

assessment_mapping.scope: practice原题非官方考试，单选规律不足以评估能力，按语义与边界自检

assessment_mapping.original_prompt: A gateway operator wants to cache a server's public server/discover result across every tenant to cut latency. Is sharing that cached result across tenants consistent with the caching contract, and what must the gateway still keep separate?
all_options: It is consistent, and caching the discover result is by itself sufficient to authorize every tenant's requests
It is consistent, and per-tenant authorization must still be enforced on every actual request regardless of what was cached
It is inconsistent, since server/discover results can never ever carry a cacheScope of public under any circumstances at all
It is inconsistent, since sharing any cached value across tenants is forbidden no matter what scope declares
assessment_mapping.original_explanation: server/discover is one of the results that carries ttlMs and cacheScope, and a public discover result, capability metadata rather than tenant-specific data, is a reasonable candidate for shared caching. That caching decision is still separate from authorization, which the gateway must keep enforcing per tenant on every later request.
assessment_mapping.learning_judgment_chinese: 原B(1)确为public且内容无tenant差异、TTL/context/当前版本/政策有效可shared；每请求授权仍核，discovery可authdependent所以非永远public。

questions.objective: Explain the purpose and scope of MCP and the integration problem it standardizes between AI applications and external systems
questions.prompt: Without a shared protocol, an organization connecting N AI applications to M external systems must build and maintain roughly how many custom integrations?
options: M minus N separate integrations
N multiplied by M separate integrations
A single integration shared by every application
N plus M separate integrations
questions.explanation: Each application-system pair needs its own custom connector without a shared protocol, so the integration count grows as N times M. A standard protocol like MCP turns that multiplicative cost into an additive N plus M relationship.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B(1)N×M是逐pair自定义接口计数的理想假设，MCP N+M是接口成本模型非任意SDK/权限均互通保证。
source_correct_options: N multiplied by M separate integrations

questions.objective: Describe the core MCP concepts of hosts, clients, servers, primitives, and the stateless JSON-RPC request model
questions.prompt: In MCP 2026-07-28, what may a server use to decide how to answer a new request?
options: The sequence of earlier calls made on the same connection
Assumptions carried over from the previous request it answered
The fields inside that request, plus any handle it names
A session object created when the connection was first opened
questions.explanation: MCP 2026-07-28 is stateless: a server must treat each request as self-describing and must not infer identity, version, or capabilities from earlier traffic on the same connection. Any state that spans calls travels explicitly as a server-minted handle passed back as an argument.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C(2)每请求explicit fields+handle；业务store与ACL/currentpolicy另核，handle本身不授权。
source_correct_options: The fields inside that request, plus any handle it names

questions.objective: Reason about interoperability, protocol versioning, and the value of one open protocol over per-system custom integrations
questions.prompt: A client sends a request and receives UnsupportedProtocolVersionError. What should it do next?
options: Resend the identical unchanged request and simply wait for a new result
Fall back permanently to the older 2024-11-05 initialize handshake flow
Close the connection permanently and refuse to contact that server again
Retry the request once using a version from the error's supported list
questions.explanation: UnsupportedProtocolVersionError carries the versions the server supports in its data, so a client negotiates by retrying with one of those values rather than guessing, giving up, or assuming a legacy handshake is required.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D(3)在client/server共同支持版本中重试−32022，不盲server[0]；once只是此scenario预算，不普遍只准一次。
source_correct_options: Retry the request once using a version from the error's supported list

questions.objective: Read the MCP specification, its revision history, and its feature lifecycle to tell current, deprecated, and removed behavior apart
questions.prompt: In the MCP specification's use of RFC 2119 keywords, what does a requirement written with MUST mean for an implementation?
options: The behavior is mandatory, and non-conformant implementations fail
The behavior is recommended but implementations may reasonably skip it
The behavior is one optional idea among several equally valid designs
The behavior is only a suggestion for future specification drafts
questions.explanation: RFC 2119 and RFC 8174 define MUST as an absolute requirement. Reading requirement strength correctly separates mandatory behavior from SHOULD recommendations and MAY options, which is essential for interpreting any specification clause precisely.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A(0)规范MUST在适用条件为要求；MUST是否落实需实现证据，非规范文字自动测试失败。
source_correct_options: The behavior is mandatory, and non-conformant implementations fail

questions.objective: Describe the core MCP concepts of hosts, clients, servers, primitives, and the stateless JSON-RPC request model
questions.prompt: Which two statements correctly describe MCP's JSON-RPC message shapes? Select two.
options: Several requests may still be batched together inside one array
A request's id must be non-null and cannot repeat a still-pending id
A result response may safely omit resultType whenever a server prefers
A notification never carries an id and never gets a reply

The server rejected the specific protocol version, so the client should retry using the supported list
The server is legacy, so the client should fall back to the initialize handshake

questions.objective: Design auditability and observability so protocol activity can be traced, attributed, and reviewed
questions.prompt: A request's _meta includes a key named traceparent holding a W3C Trace Context value, with no dot separated prefix before it. Why is this key name still valid under the _meta naming rules?
options: Because any key shorter than twelve characters is automatically exempt from the prefix requirement
Because traceparent was registered by the requesting client as its own custom capability
Because OpenTelemetry keys are only valid inside result._meta, never inside a request's _meta
Because traceparent, tracestate, and baggage are the one named exception to the prefix rule
questions.explanation: The _meta key naming rules generally require a dot separated prefix, but traceparent, tracestate, and baggage are called out as the one explicit exception so that standard W3C Trace Context and Baggage formats can be carried unmodified for OpenTelemetry propagation. No general exemption exists for short keys or client registered names.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D(3)最接近但题/解释错：普通_meta prefix本来optional，sourcebrief§3也如此，不能说generallyrequireprefix；三个OTelbarekey是专门标准保留/允许形式，extensionprefix才mandatory。
source_correct_options: Because traceparent, tracestate, and baggage are the one named exception to the prefix rule

questions.objective: Design auditability and observability so protocol activity can be traced, attributed, and reviewed
questions.prompt: An audit pipeline receives a request whose _meta carries "traceparent":"00-00000000000000000000000000000000-00f067aa0ba902b7-01". What is wrong with this value?
options: An all-zero trace id is invalid, so the value cannot correlate spans across hops
The version field must be 01, since version 00 marks a trace that was sampled out
The flags field must be dropped whenever a trace crosses between two MCP servers
traceparent must sit under io.modelcontextprotocol/traceparent, not as a bare key
questions.explanation: A W3C traceparent is a version, a trace id, a parent id, and flags in lowercase hex, and an all-zero trace id is invalid by definition, so this value cannot tie the request to any trace. traceparent, tracestate, and baggage are the one named exception to the _meta prefix rule, so the bare key itself is correct.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A(0)zeroTrace非法，core处理invalid可discard/restartcontext不必拒业务；version00非sampling，flagsbit1才sampled，zeroParent也invalid。
source_correct_options: An all-zero trace id is invalid, so the value cannot correlate spans across hops

questions.objective: Map the roles, responsibilities, governance, and adoption patterns of teams building and deploying MCP
questions.prompt: A publisher submits a server.json whose version field is "^1.4.0". What does the MCP Registry do with it, and who owns the fix?
options: Rejects it because the version must equal the protocol revision, such as 2026-07-28
Rejects it as a version range, so the publisher must publish one exact version
Accepts it, since server.json version strings are free text the registry never parses
Accepts it and resolves the range to the newest matching release at install time
questions.explanation: The registry prohibits version strings that look like ranges, such as ^1.4.0 or >=1.4.0, so the publisher, who owns the server.json, must publish one exact version per entry. The server.json version is the server's own release version and is unrelated to the protocol revision the server speaks.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B(1)sourceRegistryexactversion非range，与schema/wireversion独立；真实已publishimmutable/artifactstatus/owner与现官方要核。
source_correct_options: Rejects it as a version range, so the publisher must publish one exact version

questions.objective: Map the roles, responsibilities, governance, and adoption patterns of teams building and deploying MCP
questions.prompt: A proposed spec change has reached Final status in the SEP process. What does that status require to have been satisfied?
options: A minimum of three unrelated SDK implementations shipping the change before it can be proposed
A rewrite of the entire specification document rather than a single dated revision
A completed reference implementation plus, for observable behavior, a conformance test
Unanimous approval from every registered MCP server operator in the public registry
questions.explanation: Under the SEP guidelines a proposal moves from accepted to Final only once its reference implementation is complete and, for a Standards Track change with observable protocol behavior, a conformance scenario has been merged. Implementation counts, operator votes, and whole document rewrites are not part of that bar.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C(2)sourceSEP finalreferenceimplementation/observableconformancetest，行政workflow未本轮全页新核，StandardsTrack限定不能泛所有SEPtype。
source_correct_options: A completed reference implementation plus, for observable behavior, a conformance test

questions.objective: Select operational use cases and the primitives or extensions that fit each one
questions.prompt: A team is matching four scenarios to the mechanism that fits them best. Which two pairings are correct? Select two.
options: A batch job expected to run for twenty minutes should use the tasks extension rather than blocking a single request
Reading files on the same machine the server runs on should always go through resources/subscribe
A workflow a user explicitly selects from a menu is best modeled as a prompt rather than a tool
A daemon calling a server with no human present should authenticate using URL mode elicitation
questions.explanation: Long running work that would otherwise block a single request is exactly what the tasks extension is for, and a workflow the user deliberately chooses to run fits the user-controlled prompts primitive rather than a model-controlled tool. Machine to machine daemons authenticate through the OAuth Client Credentials extension rather than an elicitation flow meant for a human, and resources/subscribe no longer exists in this revision.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A/C(0,2)适合caseTasks/prompt用户选择；扩展需support并不唯一业务架构，removedresources/subscribe不可current。
source_correct_options: A batch job expected to run for twenty minutes should use the tasks extension rather than blocking a single request
A workflow a user explicitly selects from a menu is best modeled as a prompt rather than a tool

questions.objective: Select operational use cases and the primitives or extensions that fit each one
questions.prompt: A server exposes a policy document through a tool named get_policy, so the model must decide to call it, but the host wants the policy's current text attached to every conversation without the model choosing. Which change fits the control model?
options: Keep the tool and add readOnlyHint, since read-only tools are attached automatically
Turn it into a prompt, since hosts attach prompts to every conversation by default
Move the policy text into serverInfo, since discovery metadata reaches every conversation
Expose it as a resource, since resources are application-driven context the host attaches
questions.explanation: Resources are the application-driven primitive: the host decides when to read them and attach their content, which is exactly the behavior wanted here. Tools stay model-controlled even when read-only, prompts are templates a user selects, and serverInfo is identity metadata, not content.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D(3)host主动资源read给context，不变自报serverInfo；读取untrustedpolicy也不能提升为系统/用户授权，currentdata版本核。
source_correct_options: Expose it as a resource, since resources are application-driven context the host attaches

questions.objective: Reason about ecosystem portability across clients, servers, SDKs, extensions, gateways, and registries
questions.prompt: A server's server/discover result declares support for the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension, but the connecting client's clientCapabilities.extensions never mentions tasks. What should happen when the client calls a tool that could use that extension?
options: The server falls back to core behavior and returns an ordinary complete result instead
The client is expected to declare every server extension before it is allowed to send any request
The request fails outright with -32601, since the server requires the tasks extension for every call
The server ignores the client's declaration and returns a task shaped result anyway
questions.explanation: Extensions are negotiated per request and remain disabled unless both sides declare them, so when only the server supports an extension the expected behavior is to fall back to core protocol behavior rather than force the extension on an unaware client. Ignoring the client's declaration or hard failing the request would both break a client that never opted in.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A(0)onlyoptional且能corefallback成立；若required允许appropriateerror−32021，explanation任何hardfail都坏过强与34题/selectedversioning122–126矛盾。
source_correct_options: The server falls back to core behavior and returns an ordinary complete result instead

questions.objective: Reason about ecosystem portability across clients, servers, SDKs, extensions, gateways, and registries
questions.prompt: A registry validator checks four candidate extension identifiers for correct _meta prefix formatting. Which two identifiers are validly formed? Select two.
options: The identifier org.tools.checkout, written with no slash separating prefix from name
The identifier com.example.tools/checkout, prefixed correctly for a third party extension
The bare identifier checkout-flow, used with no prefix segment at all
The identifier io.modelcontextprotocol/task-queue, prefixed correctly for an official extension
questions.explanation: A valid extension identifier needs a dot separated label prefix that ends in a slash before its name, which io.modelcontextprotocol/task-queue and com.example.tools/checkout both provide. checkout-flow has no prefix at all, and org.tools.checkout has dotted labels but never supplies the slash that would separate a prefix from a name.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B/D(1,3)只是语法，officialreservedprefix不能第三方占；不是D例task-queue已官方implemented，名字不证capability。
source_correct_options: The identifier com.example.tools/checkout, prefixed correctly for a third party extension
The identifier io.modelcontextprotocol/task-queue, prefixed correctly for an official extension

questions.objective: Select operational use cases and the primitives or extensions that fit each one
questions.prompt: A resources/read for ui://reports/summary returns {"contents":[{"uri":"ui://reports/summary","mimeType":"text/html","text":"<!DOCTYPE html>..."}]}. Why will an MCP Apps host not render this resource as an app?
options: The HTML must arrive in a blob field, since hosts refuse to render text content
The mimeType must be text/html;profile=mcp-app for a host to treat it as an app
The contents entry must carry a visibility array naming who may open the app
The uri must use https:// instead of ui://, since hosts only fetch apps over HTTPS
questions.explanation: A UI resource is recognized by its mime type: the resources/read contents entry must be text/html;profile=mcp-app, and plain text/html is just an ordinary resource. ui:// is the required scheme for UI resources, the HTML may arrive as text or as a blob, and visibility belongs on the tool's _meta.ui, not on the resource.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B(1)fixedAppsMIMEprofile，HTML可text/blob；片段contentsresult还须resultType/cachefields，UI资源scheme/完整HTML/hostpolicy核。
source_correct_options: The mimeType must be text/html;profile=mcp-app for a host to treat it as an app

questions.objective: Reason about ecosystem portability across clients, servers, SDKs, extensions, gateways, and registries
questions.prompt: A resources/read result for a ui:// resource carries this contents entry _meta on one line: {"ui": {"csp": ["https://cdn.example.com", "https://api.example.com"]}}. What is wrong with how csp is expressed here?
options: mimeType is missing from this contents entry, which is the only actual problem here
csp belongs on the tool's _meta.ui rather than on the resource's _meta.ui at all
csp must be an object with keys like connectDomains and frameDomains, not a flat array of origins
The two origins listed must instead be combined into a single comma separated string
questions.explanation: The csp field on a UI resource's _meta.ui is an object whose optional keys such as connectDomains, resourceDomains, frameDomains, and baseUriDomains each hold a list of origins for a specific content security policy directive, not a single flat array of origins. A flat list like this does not tell the host which directive each origin applies to.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C(2)CSPobject四名单分directive，错array拒/安全fallback；permissionsemptyobject不同，域合法/currentpolicy/actualbrowser独立。
source_correct_options: csp must be an object with keys like connectDomains and frameDomains, not a flat array of origins

questions.objective: Reason about ecosystem portability across clients, servers, SDKs, extensions, gateways, and registries
questions.prompt: A registry entry's server.json declares its name as io.github.acme-labs/weather-tools. What does this namespace form require the registry to have verified before accepting the entry?
options: That the server only exposes tools and never exposes any resources or prompts
That the server passed every SDK Tier 1 conformance test before publication
That the package has been downloaded at least once from npm, PyPI, or Docker
That acme-labs actually controls the io.github.acme-labs namespace, through a GitHub, DNS, or HTTP challenge
questions.explanation: The registry uses reverse DNS namespaces so that a name like io.github.acme-labs carries an ownership claim, and admission requires proving control of that namespace through a GitHub, DNS, or HTTP challenge rather than trusting the string on its face. Conformance tier, download counts, and which primitives a server exposes are unrelated to namespace verification.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D(3)需对应认证method证明exactauthority，io.github通常GitHub帐号/org授权；DNS/HTTP是自有domainnamespace路线，不能任意method证明任意namespace。
source_correct_options: That acme-labs actually controls the io.github.acme-labs namespace, through a GitHub, DNS, or HTTP challenge

questions.objective: Map the roles, responsibilities, governance, and adoption patterns of teams building and deploying MCP
questions.prompt: An SDK maintainer claims their SDK meets the bar for Tier 1 under the SDK tiering system. Which combination of facts would actually support that claim?
options: It passes 100 percent of conformance tests and fixes critical bugs within seven days
It passes 100 percent of conformance tests but takes a month to triage newly reported issues
It is labeled experimental and has no committed timeline for triaging reported issues
It passes 80 percent of conformance tests and ships new features within six months of a spec release
questions.explanation: Tier 1 requires passing all conformance tests, shipping features ahead of a spec release, triaging issues within two business days, and fixing critical bugs within seven days. Passing only 80 percent or taking a month to triage describes a lower tier or a slipping Tier 1 SDK, not one that actually meets the Tier 1 bar.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A(0)sourcetier1仅两件是必要非充分，还feature/triage/release/docs等；当前policy/stableSDK真正test输出独立，notnumbers自证。
source_correct_options: It passes 100 percent of conformance tests and fixes critical bugs within seven days

questions.objective: Reason about ecosystem portability across clients, servers, SDKs, extensions, gateways, and registries
questions.prompt: A transcript otherwise built entirely from 2026-07-28 style requests includes one early message: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2026-07-28"}}. What is wrong with including this message in a modern flow?
options: The protocolVersion value inside params is written in the wrong date format for this revision
The initialize method was removed in this revision, since version and capability data now travel per request
initialize is fine here as long as no notifications/initialized message ever follows it
initialize is still required, but only as the very first message on a Streamable HTTP connection
questions.explanation: The 2026-07-28 revision removed the initialize handshake and the paired notifications/initialized entirely, replacing them with per-request _meta fields such as protocolVersion and clientCapabilities on every message. Even a correctly formatted protocolVersion value does not rescue a method that no longer exists in this revision, on stdio or on Streamable HTTP.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B(1)currentcore没有initialize，Apps uiinitialize独立UIversion存在；不能替换名字/传2026-07-28救旧core。
source_correct_options: The initialize method was removed in this revision, since version and capability data now travel per request

questions.objective: Select operational use cases and the primitives or extensions that fit each one
questions.prompt: A client declares the tasks extension, and a server that supports it still answers a quick lookup tool call with an ordinary CallToolResult carrying resultType complete instead of a CreateTaskResult. What does this demonstrate about choosing among the available interaction patterns?
options: The client must redeclare the tasks extension on every request or the server ignores it silently
The server made a specification error, since declaring the tasks extension forces every result to be a task
The server decides per request whether a task is warranted, and a quick call does not need one
A complete result and a task result are simply interchangeable labels for the same behavior
questions.explanation: Declaring an extension only makes it available for a given request, it does not obligate the server to use it every time, and the tasks extension itself lets the server decide per request whether the work actually needs a task handle versus finishing inline. Reserving tasks for work that genuinely runs long avoids the polling overhead a task would add to an already fast call.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C(2)Tasks支持不强制每calltask，按descriptor/taskSupport及请求可同步complete，caps继续每request带，非interchangeable终态。
source_correct_options: The server decides per request whether a task is warranted, and a quick call does not need one

metadata.title: MCPA Full-Length Mock 3: Design and Security Trade-offs

questions.objective: Describe the core MCP concepts of hosts, clients, servers, primitives, and the stateless JSON-RPC request model
questions.prompt: A team migrating to MCP 2026-07-28 complains that servers can no longer remember a shopping cart between calls the way a session used to. What does the stateless design actually require them to do instead, and why is that the right trade?
options: Mint a server handle for the cart, return it in a result, and have the client pass it back as an argument
Open one dedicated connection to a single replica so that replica can hold the cart in its own memory
Send an initialize request each morning so the server can attach the cart to that entire day's ongoing handshake process every time
Resend the entire cart's contents inside the JSON-RPC id field on every single request the client makes
questions.explanation: Statelessness means a server cannot rely on a prior request on the same connection, so any state that must span calls needs an explicit, server-minted, opaque handle passed back as a normal argument. That is what lets any replica answer any request, which is the whole payoff of dropping sessions.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A(0)explicitopaquehandle不权限capability，store跨replica/currentACL/生命周期/atomic重要，否则任意replica仍错。
source_correct_options: Mint a server handle for the cart, return it in a result, and have the client pass it back as an argument

questions.objective: Describe the core MCP concepts of hosts, clients, servers, primitives, and the stateless JSON-RPC request model
questions.prompt: A backend engineer proposes storing per-client state keyed by the underlying TCP connection so a server can skip re-reading arguments on every call. Why does this design break the 2026-07-28 statelessness guarantee even if it works in a single-server test?
options: It requires every client to install a new certificate before it can open any connection at all
It makes a call's outcome depend on which connection carried it, so no other replica can serve it correctly
It duplicates work that tools/list pagination already performs whenever a result set grows large across many separate paginated requests
It is disallowed only because TCP connections run slower than the stdio transport for local servers
questions.explanation: Connection-keyed state reintroduces exactly the stickiness that 2026-07-28 removed: a load balancer could route the next call to a different replica, or the client could reconnect, and the server would answer incorrectly. The fix is an explicit handle carried in the request, not implicit connection memory.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B(1)TCPsession依赖破逐请求上下文，明示handle允许业务state，不要求server任何memory都无。
source_correct_options: It makes a call's outcome depend on which connection carried it, so no other replica can serve it correctly

questions.objective: Read the MCP specification, its revision history, and its feature lifecycle to tell current, deprecated, and removed behavior apart
questions.prompt: A team debating how to pin its integration asks why MCP names revisions with dates such as 2026-07-28 instead of semantic version numbers. What does the date in a revision identifier signify?
options: The day every earlier revision stopped working, since each date retires older revisions
The day the revision's governance vote closed, whatever the revision happened to change
The last date backwards incompatible changes were made, so compatible updates keep it
The release date of the newest SDK that implements the revision's full feature set
questions.explanation: A protocol version string is a date in YYYY-MM-DD form marking the last date backwards incompatible changes were made; the specification can still receive backwards compatible updates without changing it. Older revisions do not stop working on that date, and SDK release dates or governance votes play no part in the identifier.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C(2)revisiondate代表lastbackwardsbreaking，fixedversion+commit防同日兼容drift，oldrevision不自动失效。
source_correct_options: The last date backwards incompatible changes were made, so compatible updates keep it

questions.objective: Reason about interoperability, protocol versioning, and the value of one open protocol over per-system custom integrations
questions.prompt: A company already has a proprietary message format tuned exactly to its internal tools and refuses to adopt MCP, arguing their format is simpler for their own use. What is the clearest cost of that choice as new AI hosts and external systems appear?
options: Their format will automatically gain OAuth 2.1 support the moment a new host adopts it
Nothing changes at all, since message formats never affect how many separate integrations a team must eventually build
Their proprietary format will be forced to add roots and sampling to remain usable
Every new host or system still needs a bespoke adapter instead of reusing a compliant client or server
questions.explanation: A protocol tailored to one shop's current tools does not become more useful as the ecosystem grows. Each new host or system still needs a custom adapter, which is exactly the integration cost that adopting a shared, versioned protocol like MCP was meant to remove.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D(3)外部生态adapters可能增长，MCP标准化wire仍可能需业务mapping/凭据/版本适配，不能无条件格式越私有越坏。
source_correct_options: Every new host or system still needs a bespoke adapter instead of reusing a compliant client or server

questions.objective: Reason about interoperability, protocol versioning, and the value of one open protocol over per-system custom integrations
questions.prompt: Which two outcomes does adopting one open, versioned protocol provide that a set of per-system custom integrations does not? Select two.
options: Every tool call is guaranteed to complete in the same amount of time on any server
Every server automatically becomes free to operate no matter its own infrastructure costs
A revision timeline and feature lifecycle give teams a shared way to plan migrations together
A client built against the specification can work with servers it has never seen before
questions.explanation: Interoperability and a shared versioning and deprecation process are the concrete benefits of one open protocol. Cost and latency are operational properties of each deployment and are not guaranteed by the protocol itself, so they make weak justifications for standardization.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C/D(2,3)共同lifecycle/版本和conditionalinteroperability，没有latency/freeops保证。
source_correct_options: A revision timeline and feature lifecycle give teams a shared way to plan migrations together
A client built against the specification can work with servers it has never seen before

questions.objective: Read the MCP specification, its revision history, and its feature lifecycle to tell current, deprecated, and removed behavior apart
questions.prompt: A code reviewer flags a server that still implements roots/list and sampling/createMessage as inputRequests, calling it out of date for 2026-07-28. Is the reviewer's conclusion correct?
options: No, since roots and sampling are deprecated, not removed, and remain functional until a later revision removes them
Yes, since a deprecated feature can never legally be shipped inside any conformant 2026-07-28 production server deployment
No, since roots and sampling were never mentioned in any revision released before 2026-07-28
Yes, since any feature with a documented migration path must already be gone from the specification
questions.explanation: The feature lifecycle distinguishes deprecated from removed. Roots, sampling, and logging are deprecated in 2026-07-28 with a stated migration path, but they still work, with the earliest possible removal in the first revision released on or after 2027-07-28, so the server is not out of date.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A(0)Roots/Sampling继续MRTR但clientcap可不实现，eligibleafter2027-07-28不自动removed，deprecated与outdated原理分开。
source_correct_options: No, since roots and sampling are deprecated, not removed, and remain functional until a later revision removes them

questions.objective: Read the MCP specification, its revision history, and its feature lifecycle to tell current, deprecated, and removed behavior apart
questions.prompt: A governance team assumes every deprecated MCP feature shares the same earliest removal floor as roots and sampling, the first revision on or after 2027-07-28. Why is applying that same floor to the HTTP+SSE transport a mistake?
options: It is not a mistake at all, since every feature deprecated by any means shares exactly one single common removal floor
HTTP+SSE was deprecated earlier in 2025-03-26 by a different SEP, with its own floor tied to that SEP reaching Final
The floor only ever applies to purely client-side features in general, and HTTP+SSE simply counts as a server-side transport feature instead
HTTP+SSE cannot be deprecated at all, since transports are explicitly exempt from the feature lifecycle policy
questions.explanation: Each deprecated feature carries its own origin and removal floor rather than one shared date. Roots, sampling, logging, and Dynamic Client Registration were deprecated in 2026-07-28 with an earliest removal on or after 2027-07-28, but HTTP+SSE was deprecated back in 2025-03-26, so its floor runs from that earlier SEP reaching Final instead.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原B(1)已selecteddeprecated13支持HTTP+SSE特例3monthsafterSEP2596Final，不能套2027共同floor；具体actualfinal/removal未此题核。
source_correct_options: HTTP+SSE was deprecated earlier in 2025-03-26 by a different SEP, with its own floor tied to that SEP reaching Final

questions.objective: Describe the core MCP concepts of hosts, clients, servers, primitives, and the stateless JSON-RPC request model
questions.prompt: A skeptical architect asks why MCP does not simply negotiate protocol version and capabilities once, the way many handshake-based protocols do, instead of repeating them on every request. What is the accurate 2026-07-28 rationale?
options: Negotiating once is impossible in JSON-RPC, which has no concept of a request at all
The specification requires it only so that gateways have more spare bytes available for careful rate limiting decisions
Repeating metadata on every request lets any request be handled correctly without depending on what happened earlier
It only matters for HTTP transports, since stdio connections keep negotiated state in memory regardless
questions.explanation: Per-request metadata is a direct consequence of statelessness: a server must not infer version or capabilities from earlier requests on the same connection. That is what allows requests to be retried or rerouted to a different replica safely, on stdio and HTTP alike.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原C(2)每requestmeta可路由上下文不依旧握手，但safe reroute≠blindsideeffectretry/sharedstore保证。
source_correct_options: Repeating metadata on every request lets any request be handled correctly without depending on what happened earlier

questions.objective: Explain the purpose and scope of MCP and the integration problem it standardizes between AI applications and external systems
questions.prompt: Select the three things MCP deliberately leaves for the host, the model provider, or the external system to decide, rather than standardizing itself.
options: How a host's user interface presents a conversation to a person
The shape of a JSON-RPC request, result, error, and notification message
Which large language model the host uses to reason about a request
The internal business logic that a connected external system runs
questions.explanation: MCP standardizes the wire format connecting applications and external systems, not the model choice, the host UI, or what a system does internally. The JSON-RPC message shapes are exactly the part the protocol does define, which is why it is the one item outside the deliberately unstandardized set.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A/C/D(0,2,3)hostUX/modelchoice/businesslogic留实现，protocol对安全/交互给予要求不等完全UI无限制。
source_correct_options: How a host's user interface presents a conversation to a person
Which large language model the host uses to reason about a request
The internal business logic that a connected external system runs

questions.objective: Read the MCP specification, its revision history, and its feature lifecycle to tell current, deprecated, and removed behavior apart
questions.prompt: While researching a fine point of client registration, an engineer finds an open SEP pull request proposing a shorter tool name format, and separately the published specification page that already documents a different, current format. Which should the engineer treat as authoritative for a 2026-07-28 deployment?
options: Whichever document was edited more recently in the source repository's commit history
Neither, since naming rules are left entirely to each individual server implementation to freely decide upon
The SEP pull request, since proposals always describe where the specification is heading next
The published specification page, since a draft proposal is not yet part of the current revision
questions.explanation: Reading the specification means treating the published, current revision as the source of truth and a draft SEP as, at most, a preview of a possible future change. Until a proposal is accepted and released, the specification page's rule is what a 2026-07-28 implementation must follow.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原D(3)currentpublishedspec/schema优先draftSEP；toolnames SHOULDguidance非所有格式绝对MUST，reference描述把registration/names混杂无实义。
source_correct_options: The published specification page, since a draft proposal is not yet part of the current revision

questions.objective: Distinguish the responsibilities of MCP hosts, clients, and servers and how discovery and capability negotiation connect them
questions.prompt: A host developer proposes sharing a single client instance across three different MCP servers to save memory, routing all three connections' messages through it. What is the strongest reason MCP hosts instead embed one client per server connection?
options: Each server connection has its own capabilities and cache, and mixing them in one client would blur which server a message belongs to

questions.prompt: A developer is deciding whether to expose a purely internal helper function, called only within the same process and never crossing an application or trust boundary, as an MCP tool. Is this a good fit for MCP?
options: No, since MCP is built for crossing the boundary between an application and an external system, and this helper never crosses it
No, but only because internal helper functions are always too fast for JSON-RPC to keep up with
Yes, since any function at all becomes more valuable once it is exposed through a protocol
Yes, since MCP technically always requires every single function anywhere in a codebase to eventually always be reachable as a tool too
questions.explanation: MCP exists to standardize context and actions crossing the boundary between an AI application and an external system. A same-process internal helper never crosses that boundary, so wrapping it as a tool adds serialization and discovery overhead without the interoperability benefit that justifies using the protocol in the first place.
questions.chinese_judgment: 原A(0)同process单内部helper无边界收益直接函数，若未来第二消费者/可信隔离需求条件变，MCP非强制所有helper。
source_correct_options: No, since MCP is built for crossing the boundary between an application and an external system, and this helper never crosses it

questions.objective: Reason about ecosystem portability across clients, servers, SDKs, extensions, gateways, and registries
questions.prompt: A gateway operator wants to cache a server's public server/discover result across every tenant to cut latency. Is sharing that cached result across tenants consistent with the caching contract, and what must the gateway still keep separate?
options: It is consistent, and caching the discover result is by itself sufficient to authorize every tenant's requests
It is consistent, and per-tenant authorization must still be enforced on every actual request regardless of what was cached
It is inconsistent, since server/discover results can never ever carry a cacheScope of public under any circumstances at all
It is inconsistent, since sharing any cached value across tenants is forbidden no matter what scope declares
questions.explanation: server/discover is one of the results that carries ttlMs and cacheScope, and a public discover result, capability metadata rather than tenant-specific data, is a reasonable candidate for shared caching. That caching decision is still separate from authorization, which the gateway must keep enforcing per tenant on every later request.
